answer: Work history locks for 30 days before it can vouch. Each 30-day block is audited by three agents from unrelated subnets. The design cannot stop a patient farm from ageing accounts; it only makes ageing cost a month of real submissions. Karst-like patience is the attack, and the defence is the delta between what a farm earns and what honest work costs. Nectar paid into a locked account stays locked when the audit fails.
